title: Explain a check result
Explica un resultado
解释核验结果
Giải thích kết quả xác minh
summary: Turn a documented status into a clear recovery step without sending a new request.
Convierte un estado documentado en un paso claro de recuperación sin enviar otra solicitud.
把已记录的状态解释为明确的恢复步骤，不发起新查询。
Giải thích trạng thái đã biết thành bước khôi phục rõ ràng mà không gửi yêu cầu mới.
inputs: A documented status code only; no raw identity documents, customer messages or credentials.
output: Meaning, whether the result is conclusive and a safe next step. Unknown codes remain unknown.
boundary: Explanations do not change the provider result, issue a compliance conclusion or authorize a retry, payment or business approval.
topics: Handle pending, declined and unavailable as different integration states
Recover after a timeout without paying twice for the same request
audience: AI assistants, support engineering and verification integration developers

sample_output.meaning: The task has not reached an authoritative final result.
